# M2-0: Carried M1 cleanup

- Milestone: M2
- Branch / worktree: `t/M2-0`, `../YNAB_AutoCategorizer.wt/M2-0`
- Depends on: none
- Touches (exclusive while running): cmd/scheduler.go (comment only), store/, sync/
- Plan refs: §2 `plan_scan`, N3. Each item below was checked against main at 219caf4.
- YNAB access: none
- Deploy: yes (steps below)

## Goal
Close three lows carried from M1 before M2 builds on these packages: a failed archived scan no longer destroys good scan
results, the live database files are private, and the scheduler comment matches the code.

## Scope
1. `sync/mirror.go` `ScanDiscretionary`: a plan that fails the scan currently gets `has_discretionary=false` and replaces
   the prior row, because `ReplacePlanScans` deletes the whole table. A failed plan must keep its previous
   `has_discretionary` and `scanned_at` (the last successful scan), with the new `scan_error` set. A plan with no prior
   row stays false. Plans no longer listed still disappear.
2. `sync.ScanError`: add `Unwrap() []error` so `errors.Is(err, ynab.ErrBudgetExhausted)` and `ErrRateLimited` work through
   it. Keep the redaction guarantee: `Error()` and anything reachable through `Unwrap` must carry no ids.
3. `store/`: database files are 0600. New files are created 0600. Opening an existing database tightens the main file and
   any existing `-wal` and `-shm` to 0600, so hoid's current 0644 files get fixed by the deploy. Skip `:memory:`. A failed
   chmod is an open error. Also confirm the `VACUUM INTO` temp file in `backup/` is not world-readable; report what you
   find in Result and fix it only if it's a one-line change in `backup/`.
4. `cmd/scheduler.go` `Scheduler` doc comment: it says any tick due during a job is dropped. Actually a job drops only its
   own tick, and other jobs' ticks run right after (see `drain` and CLAUDE.md). Comment change only.

## Out of scope
- Any behaviour change to the scheduler, or to import. `IMPORT_ENABLED` stays exactly as it is.
- `CLAUDE.md`: its Safety section already names `HEALTHCHECK_PING_URL`, so that carried low is closed.
- Other M1 lows (edit_window_closed, shutdown wait).

## Acceptance (each must be demonstrably checked)
- [ ] Test: good scan, then a scan where one plan fails with `ErrBudgetExhausted`: that plan's row keeps
      `has_discretionary=true` and its old `scanned_at`, and `scan_error` is set; other plans update normally.
- [ ] Test: `errors.Is(scanErr, ynab.ErrBudgetExhausted)` is true; the error text and unwrapped errors contain no UUID.
- [ ] Test: new DB file is 0600. An existing DB, `-wal` and `-shm` at 0644 are all 0600 after open, and stay 0600 after
      writes and after a reopen.
- [ ] `go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./...` green

Expect 600 on every file, health exit 0, and the existing Slack status message edited rather than re-posted.
